config.design: At each suffix layer explicitly supply recipient or edited cache according to fixed arm. Discard returned bus rather than persist an edited bus into later layers. All other residual paths live. Single-consumer and leave-one-consumer-out for layers11–17.
config.scope: Causal consumer attribution of three observed cache payloads, not root cause of whole model or feature/manifold recovery. Historical evaluation and discovery reported separately; no reader selected by evaluation.
